summary: First full run of Lord's Gym assessment app, backend and frontend. Backend: 14 pytest tests, 13 passed. The failure is brute-force lockout. Frontend: everything passed except one requested flow. After registering, the user is sent straight to /dashboard and never sees the /welcome gateway page. Things that worked: header nav switching between logged-in and logged-out links, hamburger menu at 390px, wrong-password error, login redirect, 7 cards (only #1 unlocked), In Progress status persisting after reload (also with localStorage cleared), submit disabled until all answered, result page, sequential unlock, a 403 error screen on a locked assessment URL, master locked overlay, master table after all 7 (Day1 1/1/1/0/0, Today 5/5/5/0/0, green +4 up arrows, total +12, 'Total out of 15'), sign out, and protected route redirect.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout does not work behind the ingress. The identifier uses request.client.host, which is the IP of whichever ingress/proxy pod handled the request, and that changes between requests. Failed attempts for one email were split across 10.39.128.26 and 10.64.133.134 (counts 2 and 4). After 6 bad attempts the 6th still returned 401 instead of 429.

minor.issue: No 'answers' Field constraints: AnswersIn accepts any Dict[str,int] (invalid ids and out-of-range values are filtered out without an error). That is acceptable, but there is no max size on the dict.

ui_bugs.issue: The welcome gateway is skipped after signup: the URL goes /register -> /welcome -> /dashboard immediately, so the 'Welcome to the gym, <first name>' / 'Begin Rep 1' page is never shown. Reproduced 3/3 times. Cause: once register() calls setUser, Register re-renders and its guard `if (user) return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />` fires after navigate('/welcome'). Login.jsx probably has the same guard (harmless there because it goes to /dashboard anyway). Visiting /welcome directly while logged in shows the correct text and CTA.

issues: 'Sign Out' (a <button>) is centered while the 'Dashboard' link is left-aligned. Add text-left / self-start to the button.
Byline is cut off ('Discipleship Training, One Rep at ...'). Consider wrapping onto 2 lines or a smaller font at <400px.
The table needs horizontal scrolling (min-w 640px), so the Today and Change columns, including the green arrows, are hidden at first. Consider a stacked or compact layout on mobile.

action_items: Fix the post-register redirect: in Register.jsx, only apply the `if (user) Navigate` guard when the user was already logged in on arrival (e.g. use a submitting/justRegistered ref), or navigate to /welcome in a way the guard does not override.
Fix the login lockout identifier: take the client IP from the first entry of X-Forwarded-For (fall back to request.client.host), or key the lockout on email only.
Left-align the Sign Out button in the mobile menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Quiz.jsx merges answers as {...server, ...localStorage}, so a stale localStorage copy wins over the server. This is fine for now, but answers saved on another device can be overwritten.
MasterResults.jsx shows the locked overlay for any error (network or 500), not only 403. It should check for status 403.
Dashboard/AuthContext: logout only clears localStorage keys starting with lg-answers-*. Acceptable.

Backend password hashes use bcrypt ($2b$12$ confirmed). Cookies are httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None (confirmed). CORS sends the exact origin with credentials=true (confirmed). There is no admin seeding (not applicable).
test_credentials: No seeded accounts; tests register TEST_user_*/TEST_ui* users with password test1234. test_smoke@example.com was left untouched.
seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ users, their progress docs and login_attempts were deleted after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/test_lords_gym_api.py. pytest.ini forces -n 2. Retest test_brute_force_lockout and the register -> /welcome flow (check data-testid=welcome-eyebrow text after submit and wait 3s). Clean up TEST_ users afterwards.
rca of the issue: 1) Welcome skip: Register.jsx re-renders with user set; its top-level `if (user) return <Navigate to='/dashboard'/>` runs after navigate('/welcome'). Navigation history captured: /register -> /welcome -> /dashboard. 2) Lockout: db.login_attempts held several identifier docs for the same email with different 10.x proxy IPs, so the count never reaches 5 on one doc.
